cohort: The study included 11.8 million deliveries from pregnant women in 43 states and the District of Columbia.
finding: Women without COVID-19 at delivery in 2020 had lower odds of PTD and SMM but increased odds of stillbirth, while deliveries with COVID-19 had an excess of all adverse outcomes, particularly SMM for Asian/Pacific Islander non-Hispanic and Hispanic women.
mod_finding: Deliveries with COVID-19 had an increased excess odds of cesarean birth by a factor of 1.07 compared to the prepandemic period.
